title: feat(console): revoke an authorized AI assistant from Connect an Agent, and an admin widget for a person's assistants
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao5pkwaKihk9gPVY4NVju7YY)_

Part of #30894 (part 2: the assistants' Revoke, plus the ui half of the administrator view. The card stays open for the server half: one "AI Assistants" tab on the `sys_user` record page that names the widget added here, filed by the seat.)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:「连接 AI 助手」页里已授权的每个 AI 助手旁新增「撤销」按钮,确认后立即收回该助手的访问权限并刷新列表;删掉「暂不支持在此页面撤销」那行提示。另新增一个管理员组件 `mcp:authorized-assistants`,放在用户记录页上即可查看并撤销此人授权的助手(目前还没有页面引用它)。
- 为什么改:OAuth 授权页承诺「可以随时在账户设置中撤销访问权限」,第一部分只做了列表;服务端撤销接口 #31048 已合并,这一步把承诺补完整,并为管理员替员工撤销准备好界面。
- 风险与回滚:只调用已上线的两个撤销接口(本人 / 平台管理员),每次撤销前都要确认;管理员组件在页面引用前不会出现。回滚即还原本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/AuthorizedAccessList.tsx(撤销流程与撤销后重读)、ManagedPersonAssistants.tsx(只从记录上下文取用户 id)、ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts(新增 5 个、删除 1 个 connectAgent.access.* 键)。
- 两分钟验证:pnpm dev 后以授权过助手的用户登录,打开 账户 → 连接 AI 助手,在某个助手上点「撤销」并确认,该行消失,该助手下一次 MCP 调用被拒绝(401)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Assistant Revoke** (`AuthorizedAccessList.tsx`). The assistants half is now its own `AuthorizedAssistantsSection`. Every assistant row carries a Revoke. It asks first, naming the assistant ("Revoke access for Claude Desktop?", the unnamed fallback for a nameless client), then calls `oauth.authorizedClients.withdraw(id)` with the row's consent id. The list is read again after every withdraw, answered or refused: a refusal is most often a grant already withdrawn elsewhere (the server answers 404 for it), so its message is shown and the stale row leaves. Revoke buttons wait while a withdraw is in flight. The `connectAgent.access.withdrawLater` line is removed. The API-key half is unchanged.
- **Administrator view, ui half** (`ManagedPersonAssistants.tsx`, new). SDUI widget registered ONCE as `mcp:authorized-assistants` (`namespace: 'mcp'`, `skipFallback: true`, so no bare `authorized-assistants` and no `app-shell:` spelling). It reads `className` from the node and one thing from the page: the bound record from `useRecordContext()`, which must be a `sys_user` record with an id. It takes no props. It renders `AuthorizedAssistantsSection` with `forUserId` = that id, which lists through `oauth.authorizedClients.listForUser(userId)` and revokes through `withdrawForUser(userId, id)`, with the same rows and confirm. Off a `sys_user` record (Studio palette, any other object's page, no id) it renders nothing. Those doors are platform-admin only; anyone else gets the server's 403 shown as a failed read, never as an empty list. No page names the widget yet, so nothing changes on screen until the server card (#31085) adds the tab.
- **Its `@object-ui/types` arm** (`zod/mcp-authorized-assistants.zod.ts` `McpAuthorizedAssistantsSchema`, TS twin `mcp-authorized-assistants.ts`), a member of `AnyComponentSchema` / `AnySchema`, so `objectui validate` claims the type instead of refusing it at `type` (the registered-types ratchet's namespaced pin stays 306). Read from the widget's read points: `properties` may only be `{}`; `body` / `children` are refused by name with the family clause. Pinned by `mcp-authorized-assistants-arm.test.ts`; the mirror-parity pair count moves 197 → 198 and the emit-headroom table gains the arm.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` imports the widget for its registration, and `package.json` `sideEffects` lists it (dist and src), as for `ConnectAgentWidget`.
- `ui/packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts` regenerated (`node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs`): one line, `mcp:authorized-assistants`. The 10859 ratchet gains a row pinning that it registered with its arm.
- **Language packs**, all eleven: added `connectAgent.access.withdrawTitle`, `withdrawBody`, `managedBody`, `managedEmpty`, `managedTruncated`; removed `withdrawLater`. Net +4 keys per pack; no existing key reworded. `zh-Hant` regenerated from `zh-Hans` with `gen:zh-hant`.
- Changeset `.changeset/30894-assistant-revoke.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/cli`: patch).

## Tests

`AuthorizedAccessList.test.tsx`, 21 cases (12 before). New: every assistant row has a Revoke; Revoke asks first naming the assistant, Cancel withdraws nothing; a nameless assistant is named by the fallback; confirm calls `withdraw('consent_2')`, re-reads the list, the row leaves, keys are not re-read and `withdrawForUser` is not called; a refused withdraw (grant gone) names the refusal and still re-reads. §5, the admin widget: registered as `mcp:authorized-assistants`; on a `sys_user` record it lists through `listForUser('user_mia')` (never `list`) and revokes through `withdrawForUser('user_mia', 'consent_1')`, then re-reads; empty and truncated lines speak of "this person"; a refused read (not an admin) is named, not shown empty; off a `sys_user` record or without an id it renders and reads nothing. The old "no Revoke, withdrawLater shown" case is replaced by the Revoke cases.

Ablation (one-off, on committed head 50879226): replacing the admin branch's `withdrawForUser(forUserId, client.id)` with `withdraw(client.id)` turned §5's revoke case red (1 failed, 20 passed); restored and verified `git diff HEAD` empty by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Where the administrator view lands.** Setup shows one user only on the `sys_user` record page, which is server metadata (`packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`, `kind: 'full'`, its own tab strip). The console has no ui-side way to add a tab there, so this PR ships the widget and the server card adds the tab: a `page:tabs` item whose body is `{ type: 'mcp:authorized-assistants', properties: {} }`. The widget needs nothing from the page but the bound record. Gating the tab to platform administrators is the server card's call; without it, a non-admin sees the 403 named.
- **Shared files with #30898**: `ConnectAgentWidget.tsx` is not touched. In the packs, keys are only added and one removed; no existing string is reworded.
- **Refusal text**: a refused withdraw shows the server's message ("No authorized assistant you may withdraw matches the supplied id.") under the list, and the list is re-read.
- Follow-up #31076 (refresh-family delete not scoped to the organization) is server-side and does not change what the console calls.

## Verification

<details><summary>Both withdraw doors, live on origin/main cb8f5200 (showcase, fresh; admin + two members)</summary>

- Own door `POST /auth/authorized-clients/withdraw`: the member's own grant 200 `{id}`, and the assistant's next MCP call 401 (200 before). Another member naming that id: 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, and the assistant's MCP call still 200. Unknown id 404; the same id a second time 404; missing `id` 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. The admin naming the member's id on the own door: 404.
- Admin door `POST /auth/admin/authorized-clients/withdraw`: member caller 403 PERMISSION_DENIED; admin with the wrong `userId` 404; admin with the member's `userId` 200 `{id}`, the assistant's next MCP call 401, and `listForUser` then answers `[]`.
- A user created through `admin/create-user` answers 403 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED on these doors until they change their password (the server's existing rule, not new here).

</details>

<details><summary>Console, live (Vite dev against that backend), head 2583f170's code</summary>

As a member with two grants (Claude Desktop, Cursor), on Account → Connect an Agent: both rows show a Revoke and the not-available-yet line is gone. Revoke on Claude Desktop opened "Revoke access for Claude Desktop? The assistant loses access at once. To use it again, it has to be authorized again."; confirming removed the row (Cursor stays). Claude Desktop's token then answered 401 on MCP while Cursor's still answered 200. The admin widget is not reachable live yet: no page names it (unit-tested, §5).

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates and tests</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/`: 2 files, 37 tests passed. With `packages/i18n/`, the plugin-form `affordanceGrantMap-12082` write census and the product-neutral ratchet: 102 files, 1859 passed, 13 skipped. After merging `origin/main` (2583f170): connect + affordanceGrantMap + `check-side-effects-array`: 4 files, 138 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` and `@object-ui/i18n` type-check: exit 0. eslint on `console/connect/` and `index.ts`: 0 errors (3 existing warnings in `ConnectAgentWidget.tsx`, untouched).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 51 commands on the final change set; all 51 exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 51 derived, 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. That includes `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0 and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (170 files passed, 2 skipped) on fec03863, which first caught the missing `sideEffects` entry (fixed in fec03863). `check:type-check-debt` exit 0 on 50879226 (the package.json change after it touches no `typecheck` script).
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (ui): 0 new citations.
- NOT MEASURED locally: the `i18n-locale-en` eager-closure ceiling (needs the Console production build; CI's `Build & E2E UI` `check:eager-closure` is the verdict). The ceiling is not changed.

</details>

<details><summary>CI fix round, head 5044eb29</summary>

- Cause of the red Test UI (6/16): `registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` counted 308 refused namespaced keys against the pin 306 — `mcp:authorized-assistants` and `app-shell:mcp:authorized-assistants` had no arm. Fixed by arming the type and registering it under one key; the pin is unchanged.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/cli/ packages/types/ packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/ packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts scripts/`: 592 files passed, 2 skipped (15956 tests passed).
- `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/cli` type-check: exit 0. eslint on the new files: exit 0. ui `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 51 derived, all 51 exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED (record: project files ui-seat-3/r2026-11-06/30894/gates-ran-p2-510c6e36.list); changeset gates re-run on 5044eb29 exit 0.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint on the touched files passes (the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
